metadata.name: workspace-enhance-hero
metadata.description: Stage-2 Enhance-hero journey driving the AI enhancement surface end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /workspace, switches to Enhance mode, and asserts the one-tap action list is populated from AIService.ListAIOperations filtered to the enhancement category (Remove background / Upscale / Unblur+denoise). It then loads an image, selects an action, and runs it — and because heavy AI models are opt-in downloads that are absent in CI (the headless-acceptance decision), the run resolves to the model-install gate via ModelsService.SelectModel (install.installed == false). Asserting the install gate appears proves the full discovery -> select-model -> hardware-fit -> install-gate wiring works against the live API. A broken AI discovery RPC, an Enhance panel that fails to compose, a SelectModel regression, or an install gate that never surfaces all fail here. The post-install run + in-canvas result + before/after are the ATTENDED acceptance gate (after a real model download) per docs/internal/DECISIONS.md; the lifecycle itself (submit -> WatchJob -> fetch-result -> compose) is unit-covered by useEnhance.test/Workspace.enhance.test.

assert.failure_message: The Remove-background action did not render — AIService.ListAIOperations discovery or the enhancement-category filter regressed.
The Upscale action did not render — AIService.ListAIOperations discovery or the enhancement-category filter regressed.

evaluate.expression: (() => { const c = document.createElement('canvas'); c.width = 240; c.height = 160; const g = c.getContext('2d'); g.fillStyle = '#3b6ea5'; g.fillRect(0, 0, 240, 160); g.fillStyle = '#f0c419'; g.fillRect(40, 30, 160, 100); return new Promise((resolve) => { c.toBlob((blob) => { const file = new File([blob], 'sample.png', { type: 'image/png' }); const input = document.querySelector('[data-testid="workspace-file-input"]'); const dt = new DataTransfer(); dt.items.add(file); input.files = dt.files; input.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); resolve('loaded'); }, 'image/png'); }); })()
